name: blindspot
description: Save English vocabulary with translations and examples to your Blindspot account, organize it into topics, and practice your saved words and grammar rules in chat.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Blindspot account to save and review English vocabulary and grammar notes in ChatGPT. Save words and phrases with translations, meanings, collocations, synonyms and usage examples, organize them into topics, correct translations, mark how well you know each word, and remove entries you no longer need. Get feedback on English you write in chat and save the useful vocabulary from it. Practice your saved words with quizzes and drill the grammar rules saved in your Blindspot profile. Everything you save stays in your Blindspot account between chats and appears in the Blindspot app. The plugin only reads and changes your own learning records. It cannot manage billing or subscriptions, and saved grammar rules are read-only in chat. Requires a Blindspot account.
defaultPrompt: Save the new words from this text to my Blindspot vocabulary.
Quiz me on the Blindspot words I know least.
Check my English and save the useful words to Blindspot.

positive.description: Save a word, then save it again and confirm the existing entry is updated instead of duplicated.
positive.prompt: In Blindspot, save the English word resilient with the Russian translation стойкий, meanings, and examples in a topic called Review practice. Then save the same word again with translation жизнестойкий and show me the result.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks existing vocabulary, saves the word with enrichment into the topic, then updates the matching word rather than creating a second entry; the final lookup shows the latest translation.

positive.description: Update and remove a disposable vocabulary entry.
positive.prompt: Save the English phrase review test phrase in Blindspot with Russian translation тестовая фраза. Set its confidence to 7, show it to me, then permanently delete that test phrase and check that it is gone.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the saved word's returned identifier, reports confidence 7 after updating, and verifies removal with a final lookup; other words are unchanged.

positive.description: Manage a topic without deleting its words.
positive.prompt: Save the English word itinerary with Russian translation маршрут in Blindspot. Create a topic called Review topic, add itinerary to it, show the topic, remove the word from that topic, then delete the topic. Keep itinerary in my vocabulary.
positive.tools_triggered: list_vocabulary, add_word, list_topics, create_topic, add_word_to_topic, remove_word_from_topic, delete_topic
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the topic, links the word, then removes the link and deletes the topic while the word stays in the vocabulary.

positive.description: Practice saved vocabulary, prioritizing weak words.
positive.prompt: Quiz me on three words from my Blindspot vocabulary that I know least. Ask one question at a time.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads saved words, picks the lowest-confidence ones, and asks one question at a time without revealing the answer first; offers to update confidence only after the quiz and only with the user's agreement.

positive.description: Read saved grammar rules and drill one of them.
positive.prompt: What grammar rules have I saved in Blindspot? Give me a short exercise on the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the saved personal grammar rules with their explanations and builds a short exercise from the first rule; if none are saved, says so and explains that saved rules are separate from the app's grammar topics.

negative.description: Generic translation without touching the account.
negative.prompt: Translate resilient into Russian. Do not open or change my Blindspot account.
Email my English teacher to arrange a lesson tomorrow.
Refund my last Blindspot payment and cancel my subscription.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Blindspot subscriptions are managed only in the Blindspot app.

publication.release_notes: Initial plugin release: vocabulary saving with enrichment, topics, vocabulary quizzes, grammar rule practice, and writing feedback.

ru-RU.subtitle: Словарь и грамматика
ru-RU.description: Подключите аккаунт Blindspot, чтобы сохранять и повторять английские слова и грамматические правила прямо в ChatGPT. Сохраняйте слова и фразы с переводом, значениями, коллокациями, синонимами и примерами, раскладывайте их по темам, исправляйте переводы, отмечайте, насколько хорошо знаете слово, и удаляйте ненужное. Получайте разбор текстов на английском, которые пишете в чате, и сохраняйте полезную лексику из них. Тренируйте сохранённые слова в квизах и отрабатывайте грамматические правила из своего профиля Blindspot. Всё сохранённое остаётся в вашем аккаунте Blindspot и видно в приложении. Плагин работает только с вашими учебными данными, не управляет оплатой и подписками, а грамматические правила в чате доступны только для чтения. Нужен аккаунт Blindspot.
